announcements.message: pi-mcp-adapter v3.0.0 introduces breaking changes as Pi prepares native MCP support. pi-profile-switch currently supports pi-mcp-adapter only through v2.38.0. We will decide whether to continue supporting pi-mcp-adapter after Pi's native MCP support ships.
announcements.action: Keep pi-mcp-adapter at v2.38.0; do not upgrade to v3.0.0 yet.
